# Cortex Terminal

> Free, open-source Android terminal app that runs Ubuntu 26.04 LTS's own programs (glibc 2.43, apt) on unrooted devices through an LD_PRELOAD library, the technique of fakechroot and fakeroot, rewritten for Android. No ptrace (not PRoot), no virtual machine, no root. An alternative to Termux + proot-distro. Apache-2.0.

Cortex runs Ubuntu's unmodified binaries directly on the Android kernel. A preloaded library inside each program maps file paths such as /usr and /etc to the app's private storage, emulates user/group ownership, and handles what Android's seccomp filter forbids; statically linked programs are patched once before their first start (static C/C++, Go 1.19+), while an immutable native helper (libcortex-exec.so) invokes Ubuntu's dynamic linker under targetSdk 35. Sessions start as normal user cortex@localhost with passwordless sudo; other users (su, runuser, PostgreSQL) are emulated for the programs, ports below 1024 are moved 8000 up, and tsu / android-su / su --android invokes Android phone root separately without colliding with Ubuntu sudo/su. Not supported without kernel privileges: systemd, mount, containers. Packages come from the Ubuntu 26.04 archive via apt. The cortex-api command gives programs Android features (notifications, clipboard, opening links and files in Android apps, sharing, battery state). APKs exist for arm64-v8a and armeabi-v7a (Android 7.0+, targetSdk 35). The interface supports 50 languages. An optional X11 desktop (Openbox or XFCE, and Firefox) can be installed from the app and is shown inside it; Ubuntu's Xvnc runs on a private Unix socket with shared PulseAudio sound and everything is drawn by the CPU (no GPU, no Wayland).

- [Source code](https://github.com/ssfuisu/cortex): repository, issues and README
- [Latest APK](https://github.com/ssfuisu/cortex/releases/latest): Cortex-arm64-v8a-signed.apk and Cortex-armeabi-v7a-signed.apk
- [Website](https://ssfuisu.github.io/cortex/): overview, comparison with Termux and proot-distro, FAQ
- [Package compatibility](https://ssfuisu.github.io/cortex/compat.html): nightly results of installing and testing common packages
- [Security](https://github.com/ssfuisu/cortex/blob/main/SECURITY.md): sandbox, permissions, verifying a download
- [Telegram](https://t.me/ratzgn): contact the developer
